name: 7023-batchdecode-0.5b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen2ForCausalLM), 24 layers, 14 query heads over 2 KV heads, head_dim 64, hidden 896, vocabulary 151936, 32768-token window, bfloat16. ~0.49B parameters, ~1 GB of weights. Ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2560 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic synthetic_text, single turn, request_format plain; every request is exactly 128 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min = max = mean on both). No sampling parameters are declared, so the engine's own defaults apply.
purpose: A compact half-billion-parameter chat assistant serving 256 concurrent users short prompts with 256-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# August-2024 vLLM: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not add keys
# from a later vLLM. Every key not written below is left at this engine's own default.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
